backend/main.mo: Main actor for the VVCEBAJA backend defining data types (Person, Achievement, Event, LockerBill, etc.), persistent maps, and public functions for user approval, admin checks, and CRUD operations on all entities.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that defines old and new actor state shapes and a `run` function that strips `lastDocumentId` and `lastLinkId` fields when upgrading to the new schema.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping three locker-access features (admin panel visibility, request persistence/admin panel, and LockerAccessGate approval flow) to their relevant frontend files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing a JSON object with one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, serving as a reference index for the project's frontend components, pages, and hooks.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS file configuring Tailwind base layers and defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens including backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar colors.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point that sets the page title to "VVCEBAJA" and mounts the React app via `src/main.tsx`.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that sets up TanStack Router with all application routes (home, about, team, achievements, events, locker sub-pages, and admin), wrapped in ThemeProvider and QueryClientProvider.
Card component that displays an achievement's image, title, date, and description, with an admin-only delete button that calls the `useRemoveAchievement` mutation.
frontend/src/components/AddAchievementMo: Modal dialog for adding a new achievement with title, description, date, and optional image upload fields, including upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddBillModal.tsx: Modal dialog for uploading a bill with title, amount, date, comments, and a required image file, using the current user's identity as the author.
frontend/src/components/AddDocumentModal: Modal dialog for uploading a document with title, description, tags, and a required file, associating the upload with the logged-in user's identity.
frontend/src/components/AddDriveLinkModa: Modal dialog for adding a Google Drive (or other) URL link with title, URL validation, and optional description, saved under the current user's identity.
frontend/src/components/AddEquipmentModa: Modal dialog for adding equipment records with name, quantity, unit price, purchase date, description, comments, and a required image upload with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddEventModal.ts: Modal dialog for creating a new event with fields for title, description, date, location, and optional image uploads with progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/AddPhotoModal.ts: Modal dialog for uploading one or more photos to the locker, showing upload progress and requiring an authenticated user identity.
frontend/src/components/AddTeamMemberMod: Modal dialog for adding a new team member with fields for name, Principal ID, role, contact info, and a required profile image upload.
frontend/src/components/BillCard.tsx: Card component that displays a locker bill with image, amount, date, and author, with download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DocumentCard.tsx: Card component that displays a locker document with title, description, tags, date, and author, with download and admin-only delete actions.
frontend/src/components/DriveLinkCard.ts: Card component that displays an external drive link with title, description, date, and author, with an open-link button and admin-only delete action.
frontend/src/components/EquipmentCard.ts: Card component that displays an equipment item with image, quantity, unit price, purchase date, and description, with an admin-only delete action.
frontend/src/components/EventCard.tsx: Displays a single event's details (date, location, description, image) in a card layout, with an admin-only delete button that calls the removeEvent mutation.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app shell with a sticky header containing navigation links, an admin panel link, user profile display, and Internet Identity login/logout handling via a shared auth hook.
frontend/src/components/LockerAccessGate: Guards the Member Locker route by checking authentication and access status, rendering appropriate UI for unauthenticated, pending, denied, or approved users, and allowing access request submission.
frontend/src/components/LockerAccessRequ: Admin panel component that lists locker access requests grouped by pending and decided status, with approve and deny action buttons for each pending request.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Standalone button component that handles Internet Identity login and logout, showing a spinner during the login-in-progress state.
frontend/src/components/PhotoGallery.tsx: Renders a responsive grid of locker photo thumbnails sorted by upload date, opening a PhotoLightbox when a thumbnail is clicked.
frontend/src/components/PhotoLightbox.ts: Full-screen lightbox overlay for viewing locker photos with keyboard navigation, download, and admin-only delete functionality.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that appears for authenticated users who have no profile, prompting them to enter their name and create a profile via the backend.
frontend/src/components/ProtectedRoute.t: A route guard component that shows a loading spinner while initializing, or a login prompt if the user is unauthenticated, otherwise renders children.
frontend/src/components/TeamMemberCard.t: Displays a team member's photo, name, role, and contact info, with an admin-only delete button that calls the removePerson mutation.
frontend/src/components/UpcomingEventsPr: Fetches all events and renders the next three upcoming events sorted by date, with a link to the full events page.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing achievements via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useEvents.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing events via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status via a React context hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerAccess.ts: Provides hooks to query the current user's locker access status, check if access is granted, and submit a locker access request.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerAccessReques: Provides admin-facing hooks to fetch all pending locker access requests and approve or deny individual requests by principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerBills.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching all locker bills, adding a new bill, and deleting a bill by ID.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDocuments.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting locker documents via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerDriveLinks.t: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting locker drive links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useLockerEquipment.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, and deleting locker equipment items via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Aggregates React Query hooks for all major backend entities including admin check, user profiles, people, achievements, events, and locker data.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeamMembers.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing team members (Person) via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfile.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current caller's user profile via the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS base imports and CSS custom properties for light/dark themes with motorsports-inspired color variables.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Static About page describing the BAJA Club with animated fade-in sections, domain icons, and a hero banner.
frontend/src/pages/AboutTeam.tsx: Team members page that displays all people in a grid with admin controls to add or manage members.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Achievements page that lists all achievements sorted by date with admin controls to add new entries.
frontend/src/pages/Events.tsx: Displays a paginated list of upcoming and past events fetched via hook, with admin-only ability to add new events via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Landing page with a hero image section and a grid of navigation cards linking to major site sections like About, Team, Achievements, Events, and Member Locker.
frontend/src/pages/LockerAccessAdmin.tsx: Admin-only page that renders the LockerAccessRequestsPanel for managing member locker access requests, with unauthorized and loading states handled.
frontend/src/pages/LockerBills.tsx: Member locker sub-page (gated by LockerAccessGate) that lists financial bills sorted by date and allows uploading new bills via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDocuments.tsx: Member locker sub-page (gated by LockerAccessGate) that lists team documents with search filtering by title, description, or tags, and supports uploading new documents.
frontend/src/pages/LockerDriveLinks.tsx: Member locker sub-page (gated by LockerAccessGate) that displays external drive links sorted by date and allows adding new links via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerEquipment.tsx: Member locker sub-page (gated by LockerAccessGate) that shows a sorted inventory of purchased equipment and supports adding new equipment entries via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/LockerPhotos.tsx: Page component for the member locker photo gallery that filters documents tagged as photos and provides an upload modal via AddPhotoModal, wrapped in LockerAccessGate for access control.
frontend/src/pages/MemberLocker.tsx: Dashboard page for the member locker showing navigation cards for Bills, Equipment, Documents, Photos, and Drive Links sections, plus an admin-only Access Requests card, all wrapped in LockerAccessGate.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to extract, persist, and clear URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage fallback for cross-navigation persistence.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom racing-themed colors (racing-red, carbon-black, metallic-silver, etc.), oklch-based design tokens, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata file tracking existing features, known issues (admin panel not visible after login, access requests not stored/displayed), and pending fix requests for the VVCEBAJA web app.
